   - Line 1 was trying to predict on `x` again (which is the training data), but the first prediction was already in cell 8
   - Line 2 (original) was calling `accuracy_score(x, y)` with `x` (the feature data) instead of `val_predictions` (the predicted labels)

I fixed it by removing the duplicate prediction call and using `val_predictions` (which was computed in cell 8) for the accuracy calculation: `accuracy_score(val_predictions, y)`

All cells now run without errors. The accuracy is computed correctly as 0.813... and represents the training accuracy (since val_predictions are from the full training dataset x).
